faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our parking services

items.question: Where is your parking facility located?
items.answer: Our parking facility is located in the heart of Piraeus, just a short walk from the Port and the city center. It's the ideal location for both business and leisure travelers.

items.question: Do you offer long-term parking?
items.answer: Yes, we offer both short-term and long-term parking options. Whether you need parking for a few hours or several weeks, we have flexible pricing to meet your needs.

items.question: How can I book a parking space in advance?
items.answer: Currently, we do not offer online booking for parking spaces. However, you can always check availability and park your car when you arrive at our facility.

items.question: Is your parking area secure?
items.answer: Yes, our parking facility is well-lit and monitored to ensure the safety of your vehicle. You can park with peace of mind, knowing that your car is in good hands.

items.question: Do you provide car washing services?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a professional hand car wash service. Our team will clean your vehicle with great care, using high-quality products and hand-washing techniques to ensure it shines like new.

items.question: What are your working hours?
items.answer: We are open Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 22:30 and on Saturdays from 09:00 to 14:00. We are closed on Sundays.
